description: Send a verification email to an end user to verify ownership of their email address identity. The end user receives an email with a link to confirm their identity. Use when you need to verify an end user's email address identity in Zendesk, such as when creating new end users or resolving identity verification issues. Note: This action can only be performed by verified end users.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for requesting end user identity verification.

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the end user
user_id.title: User Id

user_identity_id.description: The numeric ID of the user identity to verify
user_identity_id.title: User Identity Id

inputSchema.title: RequestEndUserVerificationRequest

name: request_end_user_verification

RequestEndUserVerificationResponse.description: Response from requesting end user identity verification.

sent_at.description: Timestamp when the verification email was sent
sent_at.title: Sent At

verified.description: Whether the identity has been verified. Returns true if verification email was sent successfully.
verified.title: Verified

RequestEndUserVerificationResponse.title: RequestEndUserVerificationResponse
